plugins.name: flutter-dart-code-review
plugins.description: Library-agnostic Flutter/Dart code review checklist: widget best practices, state management, Dart idioms, performance, accessibility, security, clean architecture.

plugins.name: xcode-ios-pitfalls
plugins.description: Xcode/iOS build and signing traps that pass compilation, signing and unit tests, then fail at install time or silently at runtime: hand-written Info.plist missing CFBundle* keys, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO stripping entitlements, macOS CLI rejected by TCC.

plugins.name: osyuu-skills
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic skills: release-assets ships the non-code deliverables (release notes, store screenshots, changelog, version bump); writing-standalone-skills drafts Matt Pocock-style skills whose product runs without any plugin or workflow artefacts.
